District & Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge, Deogarh for commission of offences punishable U/Ss. 376(AB)/376(3)/376(2)(f)(n)/506 of IPC r/w Section 6 of POCSO Act, on the main allegation of committing rape and aggravated penetrative sexual assault upon five victims aged about less than 16 years.

entities.text: Addl. District & Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge, Deogarh
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Heard, Mr. Akshaya Kumar Sahoo, learned counsel for the Petitioner and Mr. M.R. Patra, learned Addl. Public Prosecutor in the matter and perused the record.
None appears for the victims despite being duly informed as apprised by learned Addl. PP.

4. Bail is sought for to the accused-petitioner mainly on the ground of delay in disposal of the case,
but the allegation appearing against the Petitioner is not only serious, but also heinous and it is alleged that the Petitioner being a tuition teacher had sexually exploited some minor girls.
Right now, trial has already progressed and 15 witnesses have already been examined.

In such view of the matter and after having considered the rival submissions and on going through the materials placed on record together with the evidence of the victim, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the Petitioner.
